name: Leanne Betasamosake Simpson
shortBio: Michi Saagiig Nishnaabeg philosopher and theorist of "grounded normativity" who argued that Indigenous resurgence must be generated from Nishnaabeg intelligence and land-based kinship rather than state recognition.
centralQuestion: How does grounded normativity—ethical intelligence generated directly through land and Nishnaabeg kinship—replace settler-colonial recognition politics?

keyWorks.title: As We Have Always Done: Indigenous Freedom through Radical Resistance
keyWorks.description: Formulates Nishnaabeg grounded normativity and "kwe as method" as an anti-capitalist philosophy of Indigenous resurgence.

keyWorks.title: Dancing on Our Turtle’s Back
keyWorks.description: Reconstructs Nishnaabeg stories, language, and ethical renewal beyond settler reconciliation.
